metadata.title: A TREATISE ON THE PRINCIPLES OF CHEMISTRY

typographie_suggestion.explanation: The typeface features a strong contrast between thick and thin strokes, vertical stress, and horizontal, unbracketed serifs, which are characteristic of the "Modern" style (such as Bodoni or Didot) prevalent in academic and formal publishing during the late 19th century.
